{{Otheruses|The DarkStryder Campaign}}
The '''DarkStryder Campaign''', also known as the '''DarkStryder Incident''', was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operation to topple the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
